research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Smartcar is researching a system and method for processing vehicle requests that receives a vehicle request for a vehicle parameter from a client system, verifies client access, and determines parameter values for the requested vehicle. Based on this abstract and title, Smartcar is developing secure, permissioned access and data processing infrastructure that integrates mobility applications with connected car data. Overall, Smartcar focuses on request handling, authorization, and standardized vehicle data delivery.

overview_description.description: Smartcar enables mobility businesses to integrate their apps and services with connected cars. Easily retrieve vehicle data and trigger actions with our simple and secure car API. Track vehicle location, manage EV charging, verify mileage, lock & unlock remotely, and more. Our developer-friendly documentation and SDKs allow you to quickly integrate our car API with every tech stack.
